name: Tholos-2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, 16 query heads and 2 kv heads
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 2.517 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-01. Caveats: Tholos-Bench is the vendor's own 160-scenario agent suite, scored as pass counts out of 160 (scale 160, not a percentage). Small counts - the prompt-injection category has 12 scenarios and the card says a one-or-two-scenario gap is within noise. Summarized from a LoRA on executed synthetic trajectories; measured under Q4_K_M llama.cpp JSON-schema decoding, so the numbers carry that quant's cost.
